description_for_human: A calm, private, open-source workspace for turning a crowded day into one clear next action.
description_for_model: Task-Laureate is a free, open-source, privacy-minded, local-first task workspace for individuals. It supports quick capture, lists, priorities, due dates, tags, notes, attachments, dependencies, focused execution, progress review, search, export/import, and deliberate collaboration. Optional AI task decomposition is consent-controlled, editable, and never mutates tasks without human review. The canonical app is https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/ and the source is https://github.com/aartisr/task-laureate.
